# third_party

This directory is reserved for external code that is not vendored into the Graph-RHO release.

If you want Graph-RHO to discover L-RHO automatically, place a checkout here as:

```text
third_party/l-rho/
```

You can also keep L-RHO elsewhere and export:

```bash
export GRAPH_RHO_LRHO_ROOT=/path/to/l-rho
```
